title: A Risk Taxonomy and Reflection Tool for Large Language Model Adoption in Public Health
measurement_description: The paper did not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith/religion. It only mentioned religion once as an example of a cultural factor (beliefs about divorce) that LLMs might fail to address sensitively when giving advice on intimate partner violence.
findings: The paper does not have findings related to religion. A participant in a focus group noted that LLMs need to be culturally sensitive, using the example that certain religions' views on divorce could complicate advice given to individuals in abusive relationships, a nuance a generic LLM might miss.
